fields.label: GTIN
fields.definition: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin  for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: The GTIN identifies the model. It is stated explicitly rather than left to be read out of a SKU, because everything downstream — the Digital Link, the resolver, the passport itself — is keyed on it.

fields.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
fields.definition: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.
fields.tier_rationale: The lot. Class data describes the model; a lot is where a passport stops being the same for every item.

fields.label: Abrasion Resistance
fields.definition: Abrasion resistance in Martindale cycles.
fields.tier_rationale: Martindale abrasion result substantiates the public durability claim and reveals no formulation or supply-chain secret.

fields.label: Additional Care Instructions
fields.definition: Additional care instructions in text form.
fields.tier_rationale: Supplementary care text is consumer use information of the same nature as the printed care label.

fields.label: Benchmark Performance
fields.definition: Performance relative to product category benchmark as percentage (negative = better than benchmark).
fields.tier_rationale: Performance relative to the category benchmark is the comparative message the public footprint class conveys.

fields.label: Biodegradable
fields.definition: Whether the product is biodegradable at end of life.
fields.tier_rationale: Biodegradability status is consumer end-of-life information (ESPR Annex I).

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Class
fields.definition: Discrete performance class (A–G style band, expressed as an integer 1..n) for the manufacturing carbon footprint relative to the PEFCR climate-change benchmark.
fields.tier_rationale: The carbon-footprint class is a consumer-facing band, mirroring the public carbon-footprint class of the battery DPP.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Manufacturing
fields.definition: Carbon footprint of manufacturing phase in kg CO2-eq per product unit.
fields.tier_rationale: The manufacturing-phase carbon footprint per unit is a product-level disclosure that does not reveal facility-level operational data.

fields.label: Chemical Purpose
fields.definition: Purpose of the chemical (dye, finish, water-repellent treatment, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: The purpose of a production chemical is part of the confidential formulation detail, not of the public hazard disclosure.

fields.label: Cleaning Cycles Before Test
fields.definition: Number of cleaning cycles performed before testing (default 5 per EU methodology).
fields.tier_rationale: The pre-test cleaning-cycle count is methodology context without which the public robustness scores cannot be interpreted.

fields.label: Color Fastness
fields.definition: Color fastness rating (1-5 per ISO 105, where 5 is best).
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 105 colour-fastness rating substantiates the public durability claim.

fields.label: Colour Change Rating
fields.definition: Colour change sub-rating (1-5 per ISO 15487, where 5 is no change).
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 15487 colour-change sub-rating is part of the public robustness result.

fields.label: Concentration Range
fields.definition: Concentration range as text (e.g. '0.01-0.05% w/w') when exact value is confidential.
fields.tier_rationale: Concentration ranges exist precisely because the exact value is confidential; the range stays with the professional-detail record.

fields.label: Contains Non-Textile Parts of Animal Origin
fields.definition: Whether the product contains non-textile parts of animal origin, per the Textile Labelling Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Article 12.
fields.tier_rationale: Non-textile parts of animal origin must be indicated on the consumer label per Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Art. 12 (labelling per Arts. 14-16).

fields.label: Dimensional Change Percentage
fields.definition: Measured dimensional change as percentage (absolute value) after cleaning cycles.
fields.tier_rationale: The measured dimensional-change percentage substantiates the public dimensional-change score.

fields.label: Dimensional Change Score
fields.definition: Dimensional change component score (0-3 points).
fields.tier_rationale: The dimensional-change component score contributes to the public robustness score.

fields.label: Dimensional Change Test Method
fields.definition: Test method reference (e.g. ISO 3759).
fields.tier_rationale: The dimensional-change test-method reference (e.g. ISO 3759) makes the public result reproducible and verifiable.

fields.label: Dimensional Stability
fields.definition: Maximum dimensional change (shrinkage/stretch) as percentage after washing.
fields.tier_rationale: Shrinkage/stretch behaviour is consumer-relevant durability information about how the garment survives washing.

fields.label: EC Number
fields.definition: European Community number (EINECS/ELINCS).
fields.tier_rationale: The EC substance identifier belongs to the detailed chemical declaration; kept AuthorizedOnly to match the shared oec:ecNumber alias in every module.

fields.label: Elastane Content Percent
fields.definition: Elastane/spandex content as percentage of total weight. Content >15% (>20% for PA6-rich >80% blends) makes product non-recyclable (score 0).
fields.tier_rationale: Elastane share is fibre-composition information that Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Arts. 9 and 14-16 require on the consumer-facing label.

fields.label: End of Life Destination
fields.definition: What happens to collected items (recycled, upcycled, resold, donated).
fields.tier_rationale: What happens to returned items is consumer-facing take-back information that motivates participation.

fields.label: End of Life Handling
fields.definition: Special handling instructions for end-of-life treatment due to the substance of concern.
fields.tier_rationale: Special end-of-life handling instructions caused by a substance of concern are safety-relevant to consumers and waste operators (ESPR Art. 7(5)).

fields.label: Environmental Footprint Class
fields.definition: Discrete performance class (A–G style band, expressed as an integer 1..n) for the PEF single score relative to the product-category benchmark.
fields.tier_rationale: The footprint performance class is a consumer-facing band designed for point-of-sale comparison.

fields.label: EU Ecolabel
fields.definition: Whether the product carries the EU Ecolabel (Regulation (EC) 66/2010).
fields.tier_rationale: The EU Ecolabel is by design a public consumer label under Regulation (EC) 66/2010.

fields.label: Expected Lifetime Years
fields.definition: Expected product lifetime in years under normal use.
fields.tier_rationale: Expected lifetime is ESPR Art. 7/Annex I consumer durability information, kept Public in step with the battery module's expectedLifetime* family.

fields.label: Expected Wash Cycles
fields.definition: Expected number of wash cycles before significant degradation.
fields.tier_rationale: Expected wash-cycle count is consumer durability information equivalent to expected lifetime.

fields.label: Fabric Appearance Rating
fields.definition: Fabric surface appearance sub-rating (1-5 per ISO 15487, where 5 is no change).
fields.tier_rationale: The fabric-appearance sub-rating is part of the public visual-inspection result.

fields.label: Fiber Origin
fields.definition: Country or region of fiber origin (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).
fields.tier_rationale: Fibre origin at country granularity is a consumer-facing sourcing claim that exposes no operational facility detail.

fields.label: Free From Coatings
fields.definition: Whether the product is free from non-removable coatings (+1 pt if true).
fields.tier_rationale: Coating-free status is an externally observable sorting factor of the public recyclability assessment.

fields.label: Free From Dyes
fields.definition: Whether the product is free from dyes (+1 pt if true).
fields.tier_rationale: Dye-free status is an externally observable sorting factor of the public recyclability assessment.

fields.label: Free From Printings
fields.definition: Whether the product is free from non-removable printings (+1 pt if true).
fields.tier_rationale: Print-free status is an externally observable sorting factor of the public recyclability assessment.

fields.label: Free From Sequins
fields.definition: Whether the product is free from sequins, beads, and non-textile embellishments (+1 pt if true).
fields.tier_rationale: Embellishment-free status is an externally observable sorting factor of the public recyclability assessment.

fields.label: Garment Type
fields.definition: Specific type of garment (jacket, trousers, shirt, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: Garment type is ordinary retail product information with no confidentiality dimension.

fields.label: Apparel Subcategory
fields.definition: The specific apparel subcategory per EU Preparatory Study classification.
fields.tier_rationale: Apparel subcategory is a product classification apparent from the garment itself and used in consumer-facing product information.

fields.label: Applicable Recycling Technology
fields.definition: The recycling technology applicable to this product based on its fiber composition.
fields.tier_rationale: The applicable recycling technology tells sorters and consumers which stream the product can actually enter.

fields.label: Bleaching Symbol
fields.definition: ISO 3758 bleaching care symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 3758 bleaching symbol is printed on the consumer care label.

fields.label: Care Instructions
fields.definition: Care and maintenance instructions for the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: Care instructions are consumer use information already printed on the sewn-in label (ESPR Art. 7 use/maintenance information).

fields.label: Chain of Custody Method
fields.definition: Chain of custody method used to verify the recycled content claim.
fields.tier_rationale: The chain-of-custody model (mass balance, segregation) is verification methodology for auditors rather than consumer information.

fields.label: CLP Hazard Category
fields.definition: CLP hazard category classification (applicable to Type B substances).
fields.tier_rationale: CLP hazard categories are the basis of label elements CLP Regulation (EC) 1272/2008 puts on every consumer label.

fields.label: Cut and Sew Facility
fields.definition: Facility where garment was cut and assembled.
fields.tier_rationale: Named production facilities are commercially sensitive supplier relationships, disclosed to authorities and legitimate-interest actors only.

fields.label: Data Type Indicator
fields.definition: Type of data used in the footprint calculation (primary, secondary, or mixed).
fields.tier_rationale: Primary/secondary data typing is LCA quality metadata used by reviewers of the footprint study, not by consumers.

fields.label: Dimensional Change Test
fields.definition: Dimensional change test result component of robustness assessment.
fields.tier_rationale: The dimensional-change test result is a component of the public robustness assessment.

fields.label: Dry Cleaning Symbol
fields.definition: ISO 3758 dry cleaning care symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 3758 dry-cleaning symbol is printed on the consumer care label.

fields.label: Drying Symbol
fields.definition: ISO 3758 drying care symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 3758 drying symbol is printed on the consumer care label.

fields.label: Durability Class
fields.definition: Durability rating class (A-E).
fields.tier_rationale: The A-E durability class is the consumer-facing summary band of the durability assessment.

fields.label: Durability Information
fields.definition: Durability metrics for the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: Durability is an ESPR Art. 7/Annex I consumer-facing product parameter; this is its container structure.

fields.label: Dyeing Facility
fields.definition: Facility where fabric was dyed or printed.
fields.tier_rationale: Named production facilities are commercially sensitive supplier relationships, disclosed to authorities and legitimate-interest actors only.

fields.label: Energy Usage
fields.definition: Energy consumed in production. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with KWH unit.
fields.tier_rationale: Production energy consumption is operational facility data; the consumer-facing climate message is carried by the public footprint fields.

fields.label: Environmental Footprint
fields.definition: Environmental footprint declaration for the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: The environmental-footprint declaration is ESPR Annex I consumer-facing sustainability information.

fields.label: EU Declaration of Conformity
fields.definition: Reference to the product's EU Declaration of Conformity under the ESPR textile delegated act. Reuse oec:DocumentReference.
fields.tier_rationale: The EU Declaration of Conformity reference is a compliance document pointer; kept Public consistently with the battery module's euDeclarationOfConformity.

fields.label: Fabric Type
fields.definition: The fabric construction type of the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: Fabric construction type (woven/knitted/nonwoven) is basic consumer product information visible on the product itself.

fields.label: Fiber Certification
fields.definition: Certification specific to this fiber (GOTS, RWS, etc.). Use gs1:CertificationDetails pattern.
fields.tier_rationale: Fibre certifications such as GOTS or RWS are public marketing claims verifiable in the certifiers' public registries.

fields.label: Finishing Facility
fields.definition: Facility where finishing treatments were applied.
fields.tier_rationale: Named production facilities are commercially sensitive supplier relationships, disclosed to authorities and legitimate-interest actors only.

fields.label: Ironing Symbol
fields.definition: ISO 3758 ironing care symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 3758 ironing symbol is printed on the consumer care label.

fields.label: LCIA Categories
fields.definition: Individual LCIA category results within the environmental footprint.
fields.tier_rationale: Per-category LCIA results are study-level detail for reviewers and authorities; the public message is the PEF single score and class.

fields.label: Microplastic Information
fields.definition: Information about microfiber shedding from synthetic textiles.
fields.tier_rationale: Microplastic release is an ESPR Annex I product parameter disclosed to consumers.

fields.label: Microplastic Risk Level
fields.definition: Risk classification for microfiber shedding.
fields.tier_rationale: The shedding risk classification is the consumer-facing summary of the microplastic disclosure.

fields.label: Recyclability Assessment
fields.definition: Recyclability assessment for the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: The recyclability assessment substantiates the public recyclability claim; kept Public consistently with the shared oec:hasRecyclabilityAssessment alias.

fields.label: Recycled Content Declaration
fields.definition: Structured recycled content declaration for the textile product or fiber.
fields.tier_rationale: The structured recycled-content declaration substantiates the consumer-facing recycled-content claim (ESPR Annex I).

fields.label: Recycled Source Type
fields.definition: Type of recycling pathway.
fields.tier_rationale: The recycling-pathway type qualifies the public recycled-content claim.

fields.label: Repair Services
fields.definition: Information about available repair services.
fields.tier_rationale: Available repair services are consumer information the provider publishes to be found.

fields.label: Robustness Assessment
fields.definition: Robustness assessment for the textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: The robustness assessment is the structured substantiation of the public durability claim per the EU textile methodology.

fields.label: Robustness Test Fabric Type
fields.definition: Fabric type used to determine test thresholds (knitted vs woven scoring tables differ).
fields.tier_rationale: The knitted/woven scoring-table selector is methodology context needed to interpret the public robustness score.

fields.label: Shedding Rate
fields.definition: Microfiber shedding rate per wash. Use unitCode 'MGM' (mg/kg, UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: The measured shedding rate is the quantitative substantiation of the public microplastic disclosure.

fields.label: SoC Type
fields.definition: The ESPR Article 7(5) type classification (A, B, C, or D).
fields.tier_rationale: The ESPR Art. 7(5) A-D type classification qualifies the public substances-of-concern disclosure.

fields.label: Sorting Factors
fields.definition: Sorting factors assessment for recyclability.
fields.tier_rationale: Sorting factors are recyclability inputs derived from externally observable product features.

fields.label: Spinning Facility
fields.definition: Facility where fiber was spun into yarn.
fields.tier_rationale: Named production facilities are commercially sensitive supplier relationships, disclosed to authorities and legitimate-interest actors only.

fields.label: Spirality Test
fields.definition: Spirality test result component of robustness assessment.
fields.tier_rationale: The spirality test result is a component of the public robustness assessment.

fields.label: Substances of Concern
fields.definition: Substances of concern present in the textile product per ESPR Article 7(5).
fields.tier_rationale: ESPR Art. 7(5) requires substances-of-concern presence to be traceable in the DPP for consumers and waste operators; aligned with core oec:hasSubstancesOfConcern (Public).

fields.label: Take-Back Program
fields.definition: End-of-life take-back program information.
fields.tier_rationale: Take-back programme details are consumer end-of-life information published to drive returns.

fields.label: Tear Strength
fields.definition: Fabric tear strength. Use unitCode 'NEW' (newtons, UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Tear strength is a spec-sheet durability metric substantiating the public durability claim.

fields.label: Technical Recyclability
fields.definition: Technical recyclability assessment for the product.
fields.tier_rationale: Technical recyclability is a component of the public recyclability assessment.

fields.label: Tensile Strength
fields.definition: Fabric tensile strength. Use unitCode 'NEW' (newtons, UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Tensile strength is a spec-sheet durability metric substantiating the public durability claim.

fields.label: Textile Chemicals
fields.definition: Chemical substances used in the production of this textile product.
fields.tier_rationale: The production-chemicals inventory is formulation-level detail beyond the consumer label, for actors with a legitimate interest (recyclers, authorities).

fields.label: Verification Certification
fields.definition: Third-party certification verifying the recycled content claim. Use gs1:CertificationDetails pattern.
fields.tier_rationale: The underlying third-party certificate for the recycled-content claim is audit evidence for verifiers; the claim itself is already public.

fields.label: Visual Inspection
fields.definition: Visual inspection result component of robustness assessment.
fields.tier_rationale: The visual-inspection result is a component of the public robustness assessment.

fields.label: Washing Symbol
fields.definition: ISO 3758 washing care symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 3758 washing symbol is printed on the consumer care label.

fields.label: Waste Origin Type
fields.definition: Origin classification of the recycled waste material.
fields.tier_rationale: The pre-/post-consumer waste-origin classification qualifies the public recycled-content claim.

fields.label: Water Usage
fields.definition: Water consumed in production. Use unitCode 'LTR' (liters, UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Production water consumption is operational facility data; aggregate impacts surface publicly via the PEF fields.

fields.label: Weaving Facility
fields.definition: Facility where yarn was woven or knitted into fabric.
fields.tier_rationale: Named production facilities are commercially sensitive supplier relationships, disclosed to authorities and legitimate-interest actors only.

fields.label: Is MRSL Compliant
fields.definition: Whether the chemical complies with ZDHC Manufacturing Restricted Substances List.
fields.tier_rationale: ZDHC MRSL compliance is a pass/fail chemical-management claim brands publish for consumers without exposing formulation detail.

fields.label: Is Mono-Material
fields.definition: Whether the product is made of a single fiber type (+1 pt if true). Mono-material products are more likely to be recycled.
fields.tier_rationale: Mono-material status is a recyclability sorting factor derived from label-level fibre composition, useful to consumers and sorters alike.

fields.label: Is Recyclable
fields.definition: Whether the product is considered recyclable (score above minimum threshold).
fields.tier_rationale: Recyclability status is a consumer-facing circularity claim (ESPR Annex I).

fields.label: Is Recycled Fiber
fields.definition: Indicates whether this fiber is from recycled sources.
fields.tier_rationale: Recycled-fibre status is a consumer-facing circularity claim (ESPR Annex I circularity parameters).

fields.label: Is Repairable
fields.definition: Whether the product is designed to be repairable.
fields.tier_rationale: Repairability status is ESPR Annex I consumer information supporting the right to repair.

fields.label: Maximum Concentration
fields.definition: Maximum concentration of the substance as percentage by weight.
fields.tier_rationale: Maximum substance concentration is quantitative formulation detail for recyclers and authorities, not consumer label content.

fields.label: Meets Target Threshold
fields.definition: Whether the recycled content meets the regulatory target threshold for this product category.
fields.tier_rationale: Whether the recycled content meets the regulatory target is a compliance claim consumers and authorities can both check.

fields.label: Microplastic Mitigation Measures
fields.definition: Description of measures taken to reduce microplastic shedding.
fields.tier_rationale: Described mitigation measures qualify the public microplastic disclosure without revealing process secrets.

fields.label: Non-Textile Parts Rating
fields.definition: Non-textile parts condition sub-rating (1-5 per ISO 15487, where 5 is no change).
fields.tier_rationale: The non-textile-parts sub-rating is part of the public visual-inspection result.

fields.label: Organic Content Mass
fields.definition: Mass of certified organic fibre content (grams), per Regulation (EU) 2018/848.
fields.tier_rationale: Certified organic fibre mass substantiates an organic claim regulated as consumer-facing by Regulation (EU) 2018/848.

fields.label: Organic Content Percentage
fields.definition: Share of certified organic fibre content by mass (%), per Regulation (EU) 2018/848.
fields.tier_rationale: Certified organic fibre share substantiates an organic claim regulated as consumer-facing by Regulation (EU) 2018/848.

fields.label: PEF Single Score
fields.definition: Product Environmental Footprint single score in milli-points (mPt) per PEFCR A&F methodology.
fields.tier_rationale: The PEF single score is the aggregate result the public footprint class is derived from, without exposing inventory-level detail.

fields.label: PEFCR Reference
fields.definition: Reference to the applicable PEFCR version (e.g. 'PEFCR Apparel & Footwear v1.3').
fields.tier_rationale: The PEFCR version reference is methodology context required to interpret the public PEF score.

fields.label: PFAS Free
fields.definition: Whether the product is free from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).
fields.tier_rationale: A PFAS-free claim is a consumer-facing chemical-safety claim with no confidentiality dimension.

fields.label: Pilling Resistance
fields.definition: Pilling resistance rating (1-5 per ISO 12945, where 5 is best).
fields.tier_rationale: ISO 12945 pilling rating substantiates the public durability claim.

fields.label: Production Waste Percentage
fields.definition: Percentage of material waste during production.
fields.tier_rationale: Production waste rates are operational performance data of the manufacturer, relevant to auditors and authorities.

fields.label: Recyclability Score
fields.definition: Composite recyclability score (0-10).
fields.tier_rationale: The composite recyclability score is the headline of the public recyclability assessment; aligned with core oec:recyclabilityScore (Public).

fields.label: Recycled Content Source
fields.definition: Source of recycled content (e.g. post-consumer PET bottles, ocean plastic, post-industrial textile waste).
fields.tier_rationale: The recycled-content source description (e.g. post-consumer PET) is part of the public recycled-content claim.

fields.label: Repair Guide URL
fields.definition: URL to repair/care guide for DIY repairs.
fields.tier_rationale: A DIY repair-guide link only works as consumer information if it is public.

fields.label: Robustness Score
fields.definition: Composite robustness score (0-10). Sum of spirality (0-3), dimensional change (0-3), and visual inspection (0-4).
fields.tier_rationale: The composite robustness score is the consumer-facing headline of the robustness assessment.

fields.label: Safe Use Instructions
fields.definition: Instructions for safe use of the product considering the substance of concern.
fields.tier_rationale: Safe-use instructions are consumer safety information; aligned with core oec:safeUseInstructions (Public).

fields.label: Same Inner/Outer Composition
fields.definition: Whether inner and outer fabric layers have the same fiber composition (+1 pt if true).
fields.tier_rationale: Layer-composition equality is a recyclability sorting factor derived from label-level fibre composition.

fields.label: Seam Appearance Rating
fields.definition: Seam appearance sub-rating (1-5 per ISO 15487, where 5 is no change).
fields.tier_rationale: The seam-appearance sub-rating is part of the public visual-inspection result.

fields.label: Season Collection
fields.definition: Season and year of the collection (e.g., FW2024, SS2025).
fields.tier_rationale: Season/collection identifier is public catalogue information the brand itself markets.

fields.label: Secondary Material Fraction
fields.definition: Percentage of secondary (recycled) material by weight.
fields.tier_rationale: The secondary-material percentage is the quantitative core of the public recycled-content claim.

fields.label: Size Range
fields.definition: Available size range (e.g., XS-XXL, 36-52).
fields.tier_rationale: Size range is ordinary retail information printed on the label and shown at point of sale.

fields.label: Spare Parts Available
fields.definition: Whether spare parts (buttons, zippers, etc.) are available for purchase.
fields.tier_rationale: Spare-part availability is consumer purchase and repair information (ESPR Annex I).

fields.label: Spare Parts URL
fields.definition: URL to purchase spare parts.
fields.tier_rationale: A spare-part purchase link only works as consumer information if it is public.

fields.label: Spirality Percentage
fields.definition: Measured spirality as percentage after cleaning cycles.
fields.tier_rationale: The measured spirality percentage substantiates the public spirality score.

fields.label: Spirality Score
fields.definition: Spirality component score (0-3 points).
fields.tier_rationale: The spirality component score contributes to the public robustness score.

fields.label: Spirality Test Method
fields.definition: Test method reference (e.g. ISO 16322-3).
fields.tier_rationale: The spirality test-method reference (e.g. ISO 16322-3) makes the public result reproducible and verifiable.

fields.label: Substance Concentration
fields.definition: Concentration of the substance in the product as percentage by weight (w/w).
fields.tier_rationale: Exact substance concentrations are commercially sensitive formulation data; the public tier carries the qualitative presence disclosure instead.

fields.label: Synthetic Fiber Content
fields.definition: Total percentage of synthetic fibers that may shed microplastics.
fields.tier_rationale: Aggregate synthetic-fibre share is fibre-composition information required on the consumer label by Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Arts. 9 and 14-16.

fields.label: Take-Back Incentive
fields.definition: Description of incentive for returning products (discount, voucher, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: The return incentive is consumer end-of-life information; aligned with core oec:takeBackIncentive (Public).

fields.label: Take-Back Program Available
fields.definition: Whether a take-back program is available for this product.
fields.tier_rationale: Take-back availability is consumer end-of-life information that only works if public.

fields.label: Take-Back URL
fields.definition: URL with take-back program information and collection points.
fields.tier_rationale: The take-back link is consumer end-of-life information; aligned with core oec:takeBackUrl (Public).

fields.label: Technical Recyclability Score
fields.definition: Technical recyclability component score based on applicable recycling technology.
fields.tier_rationale: The technical-recyclability component score contributes to the public recyclability score.

fields.label: Textile Fibre Scientific Name
fields.definition: Scientific (binomial) name of a textile fibre, e.g. \"Gossypium hirsutum\" for cotton, required alongside the common fibre name for certain fibres under the EU Textile Labelling Regulation.
fields.tier_rationale: The scientific fibre name accompanies the fibre name in consumer-facing labelling for certain fibres under Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 (labelling per Arts. 14-16).

fields.label: Visual Inspection Score
fields.definition: Visual inspection component score (0-4 points).
fields.tier_rationale: The visual-inspection component score contributes to the public robustness score.

fields.label: Visual Inspection Test Method
fields.definition: Test method reference (e.g. ISO 15487).
fields.tier_rationale: The visual-inspection test-method reference (e.g. ISO 15487) makes the public result reproducible and verifiable.

fields.label: Weight Excluding Trims
fields.definition: Product weight excluding trims and accessories (grams), used for recycled/organic content denominators. Use gs1:netWeight for the total product weight.
fields.tier_rationale: Net textile weight is needed to interpret the public recycled/organic content percentages and carries no competitive sensitivity.
